summary: Rainier Acquisition Corp, a Cayman-domiciled Nasdaq-listed blank-check company, filed an 8-K on September 11, 2026 announcing that holders of its IPO units may, commencing September 14, 2026, elect to separately trade the underlying Class A ordinary shares and one-quarter warrants. The separated shares and warrants begin trading September 15, 2026 on the Nasdaq Capital Market under RNAQ and RNAQW; unseparated units remain RNAQU. Each whole warrant is exercisable at $11.50 per share. Continental Stock Transfer & Trust serves as transfer agent. This is a routine SPAC unit-separation mechanics event, not a business combination; no trust, redemption, or deal terms are disclosed. Watch for the eventual de-SPAC timeline and redemption overhang.
